tabs_help.Long video: The daily YouTube video: how long it is, how long each match stays, the timing of the picks, quality.
tabs_help.Match card: How each match card looks in the video (and the Shorts): card style, Champions League card, colours, labels, fonts, what is shown.
tabs_help.Intro and end: The start of the video, the subscribe and bell moment, the banker part, the end screen.
tabs_help.Music and voice: Music for the video and the Shorts, and your own voice files (Voices folder): on or off, loudness.
tabs_help.Live scores and results: Following the matches live, full time messages, the results and the winning posts.
tabs_help.Phone app: Your Match Vision phone app: what the laptop sends it and how it updates itself.
tabs_help.Laptop off (cloud): What GitHub posts for you when the laptop is OFF (morning posts, win tickets, results).
tabs_help.Music: Music for the video and the Shorts.
tabs_help.Thumbnails: Three thumbnails are made for every video, for YouTube "Test and compare".
tabs_help.Shorts: The Shorts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Telegram and WhatsApp. Never posted on YouTube.
tabs_help.Pictures: The swipe post (all games, top picks, banker, follow slide) for Instagram, TikTok, X, Threads and YouTube Community, and the pictures for your channels.
tabs_help.Banker: The 2 Odds Banker: the safest 2 or 3 picks of the day together.
tabs_help.Texts: Titles, descriptions and captions. Every word is edited in the window "Texts and captions" (left buttons): the picture on top, the caption under it, Save.
tabs_help.Accounts: 3.40: account A (videos), account B (pictures), X. Names and handles.
tabs_help.Automatic: API-Football: which matches the builder chooses, and how it predicts. Connect your key with Connect.bat.
tabs_help.Telegram: The Match Vision bot on your phone. Connect it with Connect.bat.
tabs_help.Review: The review on Telegram, in order: matches, thumbnails, intro, video, Shorts, pictures, title and captions. For each step: Ask me, or use my Settings (Change every day / Always this one are in the other tabs).
tabs_help.Channel: The day on your channels: 06:00 the games, then the video post with its link as soon as you share it to the bot. The Telegram channel is posted by itself; the WhatsApp channel and X versions come to you ready to copy.
tabs_help.Daily jobs: What the bot does by itself every day. The laptop must be on (or asleep) with the bot running.
tabs_help.Stickers: The thin stickers on your Telegram channel before each part of the day. Each one has its own switch and its own style (10 styles). Send the bot "stickers" to see them on your phone.
tabs_help.Posting times: EVERY time of the day in one place (24-hour clock, Ghana time). The cloud posts at the same times when the laptop is off.
tabs_help.VIP bot: What happens when someone messages your bot: the VIP menu, payments (you approve), terms, winning tickets, questions. The words are in Texts and captions (VIP BOT parts).
tabs_help.YouTube upload: The video goes to YouTube by itself, scheduled. You only add the end screen in YouTube Studio.
tabs_help.YouTube comments: Replies to comments on your videos, shown to you first.
tabs_help.Game checker: Checks the games you send before the build: wrong day, too early, too late, postponed.
tabs_help.Vision Premium: Your private paid room. Members get the strongest picks first. Members: send the bot "member Kofi 1 month", "renew Kofi 1 month", "remove Kofi" or "members". The words are in Texts and captions (PREMIUM parts).
